summary: No EPLB weight rearrangement in the model: eplb-state has only add-model and start-async-loop; EplbState.rearrange / rearrange_expert_weights_inplace (rebalance_execute.py:642) and the EPLB communicator are missing, so per-rank expert placement after a reshuffle cannot be asserted.

Asserts GSM8K accuracy of ROCm P/D disaggregation with AITER kernels (below the model); its secondary KV-transfer counter check also has no model target (no P/D proxy flow, no prompt_tokens_by_source / nixl_bytes metrics).
Only asserts lm_eval GSM8K accuracy >= threshold under TP/PP/DCP; model accuracy is below the model.

MoRIIO config construction is missing: no interface validates transfer_timeout/defer_timeout/recv_abort_timeout as finite and > 0 (moriio_common.py:49-53, 345-368); moriio-writer takes defer_timeout_ms as unvalidated seeded state.
Checks that the file-backed HF3FS mock client creates a backing file of the given byte size on disk; filesystem detail below the model.
